extracted.intended_audience: PR and communications professionals, corporate marketing/communications teams, and organizations preparing press releases for distribution
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for preparing and distributing press releases via a commercial newswire service (PR Newswire/Cision), including editorial standards, targeting, multimedia, tracking, security, and paid placement options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial proofreading and review
rubrics_metrics.description: Our editorial team—available 24/7—proofreads every news release for grammar, spelling, punctuation, broken links, proper tagging for your target industries and SEO-related guidelines to optimize your immediate and long-term search performance along with other public relations best practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PR Newswire reviews releases around the clock; they review over 325,000 press releases annually and in 2022 caught over 22,000 mistakes in client copy. Use the editorial review to catch mechanical errors and ensure release readiness before distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proper tagging for industries and SEO optimization
rubrics_metrics.description: Releases should include proper tagging for your target industries and adhere to SEO-related guidelines to optimize search performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accurate industry/vertical tags and metadata so the wire can route and surface your content to relevant beats and improve both immediate visibility and long-term discoverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include multimedia to maximize engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Press releases that include multimedia generate up to 6x greater engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quickly upload photos, videos, logos, infographics, and other dynamic content; organize and embed multimedia into releases, share visuals on the multimedia newswire, display them on thousands of syndicated websites, and archive them in the digital newsroom to boost pickup and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target your audience precisely
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose your target audience by countries (170+, in 40+ languages), states or provinces, regions, cities, industries, verticals, beats (e.g., ESG), demographics and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the wire's targeting options to narrow distribution to the geographic, industry, beat, or demographic segments most relevant to your story to improve relevance and pickup rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track results and measure effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Track impressions, site postings and more for every native ad and article you place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use provided analytics to demonstrate effectiveness, monitor pickup and readership, and fine-tune subsequent campaigns based on impressions, site postings, and other performance metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use shareable quotes and structured fields
rubrics_metrics.description: The PR Newswire Amplify interface includes fields that emphasize sections like a specific quote you want to be shared.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Populate structured fields (e.g., highlighted quote) to make it easy for journalists and aggregators to find and reuse the most newsworthy or quotable elements of your release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage wide distribution networks for reach
rubrics_metrics.description: Put your story in front of the industry's largest global audience of print, broadcast, and digital journalists and influencers: 440,000+ newsrooms, websites, direct feeds, journalists and influencers; 270,000+ journalist inboxes; 9,000+ digital media outlets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the breadth of distribution (global, national, local, trade) appropriate to your goals to maximize visibility across print, broadcast, and online channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use guaranteed paid placement for strategic visibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Cision’s Guaranteed Paid Placement converts the content of your press release into a digital media asset that can be simultaneously and strategically placed on major media outlets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider paid placement when you need assured visibility on target sites—paid placement places assets on major outlets your audience prefers and trusts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain control of your narrative (write in your own words)
rubrics_metrics.description: Press releases allow you to tell your story—in your own words—without interpretation from others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft clear, direct copy that states your message and facts plainly so distribution transmits your intended framing to journalists and audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security and data protection for content and customer data
rubrics_metrics.description: PR Newswire is compliant with SOC 2 Type II, the most comprehensive and rigorous security standard for third-party cloud services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose distribution partners that safeguard sensitive data and handle your content responsibly to protect your business and reputation; rely on vendor compliance certifications when assessing risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage vendor support and responsiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Cision PR and Communications experts take the time to understand your strategy, goals and challenges and the support team is available and knowledgeable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work with vendor account teams and support to test placements, resolve issues, and get visibility into release pickup; a responsive support team can improve execution and client confidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use digital newsroom/archive for ongoing visibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Easily organize and embed multimedia content into your press releases and archive them in our exclusive digital newsroom, PR Newswire for Journalists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain an accessible archive of releases and media assets to aid journalists, improve discoverability, and sustain long-term visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format and completeness (upload and submit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Upload your press release to the wire and ensure the release includes required fields and attachments for distribution and syndication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete all submission fields (headline, dateline, body, contact, multimedia, tags) and verify links and attachments during editorial review to avoid preventable errors or rejections.
